ruleDefinitions.name: File Download And Execution Via IEExec.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the IEExec utility to download and execute files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\IEExec\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "IEExec\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*")))
